P.text: On CLOB fill, filled amounts are rounded down to the nearest lot; FOK fill orders should not revert if only the amount rounded off is left unfilled, and the user is not charged for the dust.

I.text: FOK orders should not revert due to rounded-off input amounts, and dust should be tolerated.

V.text: When amountIsBase is true, there is no equivalent excess-dust handling logic, so any order with amount not divisible by lot size reverts; FOK orders revert because of rounded-off input amounts, contrary to the README.
V.evidence_quote: There is no equivalent logic when amountIsBase is true, which means that any order with its amount set to any value not divisible by lot size will revert.
